instruction: Keep going to the previous song on Spotify until you reach a song I have already liked.
notes: The queue is abstracted as a short backward chain (current -> previous-1 -> previous-2) where only previous-2 is liked; at runtime the number of previous_song calls is whatever it takes to reach the first liked song found by comparing show_song_queue entries against show_liked_songs. prev-in-queue and liked are world facts (not agent knowledge); the knowledge predicates queue-known and liked-songs-known gate previous_song so the agent gathers the queue and liked list before moving. previous_song is only allowed from a non-liked song, encoding 'until you reach a liked song' (no overshoot). The goal demands the cursor rest on the liked target and only cursor_position changes (no other state is touched). complete_task takes no answer; its song parameter is a non-API record identifying the reached song.
